vacancy.title: Product Assurance & Safety Support Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Official detail page has an invalid last-apply date ('28/20/2026'). The official overview appears to display a rolling date exactly six months ahead (20 April on 20 October; 22 April on 22 October; 23 April on 23 October), not a verified fixed closing date. Deadline is therefore unknown until explicitly confirmed. Senior PA&S role supporting ESA manufacturing, inspection, AIT and nonconformance activities; requires 10 years space-sector experience including 5 years PA/QA.
